items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or losing forward gears
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transaxle with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost around $2,500.

items.t: Clogged fuel pump filter can cause stalling (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford or Lincoln-Mercury dealer

items.t: Battery cable can short and cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford or Lincoln-Mercury dealer

items.t: Brake lights can fail or stay on (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford or Lincoln-Mercury dealer

items.t: Rear brakes can lock up from a faulty valve (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford or Lincoln-Mercury dealer

items.t: Blower motor resistor can overheat and melt (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford or Lincoln-Mercury dealer

items.t: Door may not latch and could open while driving (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford or Lincoln-Mercury dealer

items.t: Accelerator cable can stick (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford or Lincoln-Mercury dealer

items.t: Alternator failure, dim lights and stalling
items.job: Replace alternator and repair wiring connector

items.t: Battery light on but charging seems fine
items.job: Check fuses and charging system; bulletin repair

items.t: Power steering fluid leaks and heavy steering
items.job: Replace power steering pressure line or steering rack
items.note: A line or seal is far cheaper than a full rack. CarComplaints lists about $1,300 for a rack.

items.t: Timing belt shredding (2.0L)
items.job: Replace timing belt and tensioner

items.t: Hard starting in freezing weather (2.0L)
items.job: Cold-start bulletin repair or engine software update

items.t: Hard start or rough idle after a hot soak (V6)
items.job: Hot-start bulletin repair or engine software update

items.t: Rough idle and stalling from cam timing codes (2.0L)
items.job: Replace variable cam timing solenoid and bulletin repair

items.t: Lean codes from vacuum leaks
items.job: Smoke test and replace vacuum hose or intake gasket

items.t: Check engine light for EGR flow codes
items.job: Replace EGR pressure sensor and hoses or clean EGR passages

items.t: Hesitation or surge between 3,000 and 4,000 rpm
items.job: Engine computer update per bulletin

items.t: Cracked intake valves can damage the V6
items.job: Cylinder head repair with new valves
items.note: Cost depends on whether only the head or the whole engine is damaged.

items.t: Heater core leak
items.job: Replace heater core

items.t: Shifter stuck in Park with the brake pressed
items.job: Repair brake light switch or shift interlock

items.t: Exhaust flange studs break and rattle
items.job: Replace exhaust flange studs and gasket

items.t: Rotten egg smell from the exhaust
items.job: Bulletin repair or engine computer update

items.t: Fuel gauge drops to empty with fuel in the tank
items.job: Replace fuel level sender

items.t: Slow fill and pump nozzle keeps shutting off
items.job: Replace fuel filler pipe

items.t: Low coolant light on with a full tank (V6)
items.job: Replace coolant level sensor per bulletin

items.t: Power door locks lock and unlock by themselves
items.job: Repair door lock switch or wiring

items.t: Liftgate will not open from the button or remote
items.job: Adjust or replace liftgate latch

items.t: Alarm goes off when starting or by itself
items.job: Alarm system diagnosis and repair

items.t: Brake groan, grind or squeal
items.job: Replace brake pads with revised parts

items.t: Starter grinding or no crank
items.job: Repair starter wiring or replace starter

items.t: Headlight condensation
items.job: Reseal or replace headlamp assembly
